blocks.text: Abylay Nurlybek / Violin, Arsen Omarbayev / Violin, Azarin Mustafazade / Piano, Dragon Lau Kei Lung / Piano, Jason Lam Ching Yin / Piano, Matthew Yu Shing Fung / Cajon, Satkozy Mukhtar / Kobyz, Shaikos / Bass, Yiwen Miao / Voice
Classical Salon Halloween Edition X in partnership with HKBU Academy of Music Thursday, Oct 29, 2026 8.30pm – 10.30pm
Ping Pong Gintonería 129 Second Street L/G Nam Cheong House Sai Ying Pun, Hong Kong +852 9035 6197 Monday – Sunday, 6pm till late

Ping Pong Gintonería continues its collaboration with HKBU Academy of Music (HKBUMUS), presenting a recital that highlights the technical command and interpretive depth of the Academy’s emerging artists.

Programme Prokofiev Sarcasms (Sarkazmy), Op. 17 Schubert Der Tod und das Mädchen Shchedrin In the Style of Albéniz J. S. Bach Partita No. 2 in D minor, BWV 1004: III Sarabande Beethoven Piano Sonata No. 32 in C, 1st mvt.
